topics.description: An ICE agent fatally shot a man during an immigration operation in Houston, sparking protests and calls for an independent investigation. The incident has raised concerns about the use of force by ICE agents and the need for greater transparency in such operations.

The FBI has been conducting investigations into organized crime groups, including a recent arrest of 24 individuals in a major probe into India-based organized crime. These investigations aim to disrupt and dismantle organized crime networks.
